card.name: Digits inside numbers in dose tables
card.fires_on: A single digit that comes after the first digit of a multi-digit number or decimal, such as the 3 in 23 or the 4 in 0.4. It appears in dose tables, dose lists and price sums, where the number is not finished yet.

modes.label: Second digit of whole numbers
modes.description: The last digit of a two-digit number in a dose list or table row.

modes.label: Digit after a decimal point
modes.description: A digit right after a leading 0. or in a decimal amount of mL or dollars.
